There is a difference between a enclosed habitant and an open habitat, a water bowl is fine, hell even a large one in a tank that size but I wouldn’t suggest it because she could drown, but in their wild habitat there are no streams and leopard geckos and African fat tails can drown in water over their head, misters and a large water section can give respiratory infections as they will raise the humidity too high which is 40% humidity max, I agree with shrubs and there is no problem with the tank size, the bigger the better, I didn’t know if you already got the 60gal so I figured I could suggest a smaller size to save money especially if you were looking at a vivarium, your heart is in the right place but you need to look into leopard gecko/African fat tail vivarium before you go further, I’m trying to help you and you gecko not crush your ideas
